reviews.scope: Four frozen contract/projection sources and tests numbered 1–4 in the committed quote PDF plan. Full source reading and read-only comparison of the two implementation files against the plan commit.

authorship.note: Independent for these four files; this note is not an independent review of the reviewer's related browser implementation. The separately authorized browser test-only mutable-owner fixture repair is outside this review scope.

observations.result: The estimate selector is PDF-only with exact six keys, canonical untransformed ID and positive safe F/E below MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Estimate snapshots require the old fifteen fields plus exactly one estimate metadata field; invoice/report snapshots still reject that field. Captures detach and freeze data without invoking accessors. Metadata itself has exactly seven fields, matching the actual plan type.

Tenant, F, L, language and expected selector correlate; L cannot exceed F. E/ID match both the selector and the replayed source estimate. C/S are separately validated positive revisions, repeated exactly in facts, without equating their numeric values to F or each other. Status is draft/accepted/declined and agrees between metadata/facts/source. Configuration must canonically equal the replayed book configuration. Missing/stale source and identity mismatch have distinct closed errors. The old two-argument builder rejects estimates.

Quantities and cents stay in canonical strings/BigInt. Both projection and snapshot validation use the existing two-stage half-away-from-zero money calculation: gross first, then its line discount. Each net and the sums of gross/discount/net are checked, including subtotal minus discount equals net. Basis points are canonical 0–10000. Static tests cover fractional ties, zero/full discounts and values beyond Number precision. No quote tax, received, credited or outstanding columns/totals are invented.

Recipient fields come solely from estimate.customer, preserving the historical snapshot after a customer edit until explicit quote resave. Issuer comes solely from the separately captured current US identity and its configuration address, with current_at_export and before_sales_tax disclosed. Invoice issuance identities remain sourced from their own immutable snapshots; there is no fallback to another invoice or to the current customer card.

observations.area: Bounded complete documents and synchronous capture
observations.result: Source book, selector and private identity are captured before replay yields. Projection uses all persisted estimate lines, independently of UI page/form limits. The reused structural capture enforces value-character/node/depth budgets, rejects oversized array length before result-array allocation, then the estimate-only complete serialized snapshot is limited to 2097152 UTF-8 bytes. No raw-input JSON serialization occurs before structural capture. This is a postcapture output budget, with the property-name limitation stated separately below.

Read-only diff against 26b14fd shows invoiceSnapshot and reportSnapshot bodies unchanged, common runtime fields unchanged, and the old builder retains its two-argument path for all old selectors. Existing column/total definitions and arithmetic branches are preserved. The UTF-8 snapshot cap and identity requirement apply only to estimate. Validator capture/schema ordering changed to select the new variant; no concrete valid-old-payload regression was found by static reading.

documentedLimits.limit: The reused capture counts string values, not characters in property names. An otherwise valid quote snapshot with an additional very large string key and numeric value reaches JSON serialization/UTF-8 encoding before strict key rejection. Therefore the 2MiB postcapture check is not a guarantee of bounded memory for arbitrary hostile property names. This was reported during review, then corroborated as an already documented scope limitation: the server constructs the closed snapshot, and no browser snapshot JSON body is accepted. No source repair was requested by this note, and no preallocation/memory-safety guarantee is claimed.

These four files validate and project presentation data. They do not authorize a tenant, establish seller freshness, or provide an atomic F/C/S/Auth transaction. Real admission and final identity/head fences belong to the separately reviewed HTTP/backend path.

Static review only. The reviewer executed no tests, types, lint, build, PostgreSQL/PGlite, server, browser or network operation. Test assertions were read, not rerun. No PDF was rendered or inspected in this review. Parent-owned serialized checks and real renderer/UI evidence remain separate; this note does not alter any failing attempt or certify the whole product.

reviews.sourceMutation: No edits to the four reviewed sources or their dependencies. Only this ignored review note was created for this task.

reviews.scope: Eight backend files numbered 5–12. Initial complete static review and v2 failure-path reread are retained for unchanged files. This final pass rereads the amended identity reader, identity tests, binding tests and PG fixture, the binding, route and server admission/final-fence path, and hashes all eight actual working files. The subsequent v8 delta is test-only explicit string/URL/Request handling in the synthetic fetch callback; it was read separately and all eight working hashes were recaptured. resolvedFindings.resolution: Pre-code plan amendment d500242 specifies the private exact seller-head select. Binding and genuine PG helper now consume that reader inside unchanged repeated full admission. The mixed recipe corrects S1→S2 only before promotion, after its historical invoice is created; separate post-promotion correction and no-op attempts must reject PF008/PU008 and preserve exact identity heads/histories. The old reader/service, SQL guard, grants and triggers are unchanged.
resolvedFindings.verification: Static amended-source review; parent-owned diagnostic-pg-v3 execution is separate and no pass is claimed here.

observations.result: Actor is detached before waiting, select is captured from an own or immediate-prototype data descriptor and bound to the actual client. The fixed relation is zentra_us_seller_profiles, fixed projection is organization_id,revision,profile,updated_by,updated_at, fixed query has only exact tenant eq.<captured organizationId> and limit1. Returned JSON is detached; more than one row, foreign tenant, missing/extra fields, unsafe revision, invalid profile/audit/timestamp or upstream failure closes503. Zero rows returns only explicit unconfigured state. Existing closed seller validator is reused; no caller chooses table/columns/tenant. Unit source covers a real client prototype, microseconds, getters, captured actor/method and owned output.

observations.area: Application authorization, not independent SQL admission
observations.result: This is a private server service_role/secret-key SELECT under repeated application admission, like the country head read. The isolated seller SELECT neither carries grant/capability to PostgreSQL nor proves tenant authorization by itself. Its supported quote binding surrounds C1→S→C2 with full Auth/D1, financial role/management entitlement, TEST gates, opt-in/grant/policy and configuration admission before/after successful and rejected waits. It is not a new admitted RPC, atomic identity snapshot, RLS grant or general public seller route. No privilege is obtained from public profile fields.

observations.area: Current identity correlations and final fences
observations.result: C and S stay distinct positive safe version values; closed country envelope and US/USD/accrual configuration are validated and detached. C1/C2 revision and canonical configuration must match. Exact source F and saved quote E/existence precede seller reads. Current captured configuration must match admitted configuration/book. The saved quote supplies the historical customer. After render/hash, complete current identity is reread/compared, then exact F and full admission are checked. No other invoice, current customer card, CH seller, tax merchant or provider supplies fallback identity. Successive observations are not one Auth/D1/F/C/S transaction.

Quote GET accepts exactly four unique query keys revision/estimateRevision/language/format, positive safe F/E and pdf-only. Thin route delegates the Request and resolved tenant/ID without identity injection. Safe deterministic filename and E/C/S/current_at_export metadata correlate to captured selector/identity, with private profiles/config/authority omitted. No current quote identity is required by old invoice/report branches. Read/head are the only private financial store methods consumed.

Existing URL4096, total deadline/abort, owned fonts each<=2MiB, owned PDF output<=12MiB, PDF signature/EOF and exact hashes remain. Closed snapshot validation precedes render and public failures remain one bounded error field. Quote snapshot capture/2MiB and rendering internals belong to separate contract/renderer reviews; the accepted post-capture limit does not imply arbitrary-key-name preallocation memory bounds.

Existing grants already permit private service_role seller SELECT; anon/authenticated remain revoked and no grant/RLS/SQL change appears in this repair. Foundation still wraps legacy seller RPC with PU008 and freezes seller/country heads plus histories on promotion. New reader intentionally avoids that closed legacy RPC for a private current head observation only; it does not reopen legacy writes, receipts, dispatcher or independent ledger. PG source explicitly expects the old seller RPC to remain PU008.

observations.area: Genuine PostgreSQL identity lifecycle versus memory fences
observations.result: PG adapter performs actual service_role exact native selects. Historical invoice owns S1; genuine seller correction S2 is applied by existing put RPC after invoice creation and before promotion. Mixed quote asserts current S2 issuer versus old invoice S1. Post-promotion changed and no-op country/seller put calls must reject PF008/PU008 during rendering, then exact heads/histories/source/bank data and unchanged identity are asserted. No triggers are removed, and no privileged DML is used to advance C/S. C/S changes during waits remain controlled memory handler scenarios; those are not proof that post-promotion SQL identity edits are available.

observations.area: Cumulative migration recipes and preserved history
observations.result: Historical32 recipe and retained NodeFS output are separate from cumulative34 quote database (existing invoice_dto1 and bank_test_v1 appended). Mixed source includes real V5 receipts/payment/credit/manual/purchase and completed bank register. Source assertions preserve invoice/ledger/counters/bank state/completion, keep saved quote customer through current customer correction until explicit resave, and compare exact source/identity/receipts across clean close/new-instance reopen. Rendering checks actual PDF structure, Letter size and content hash; temporary diagnostic scaffolding is removed but old diagnostic artifacts remain. These are assertions read in source, not reviewer execution results.

resolvedFindings.priority: P1 for targeted test validity only
resolvedFindings.scenario: New quoteFixture sends synthetic pdf bytes through the true export server, which requires %%EOF. The original transport marker lacked it and would make quote happy paths return503.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Owner added newline+%%EOF to the synthetic marker; final source read confirms this. Marker remains explicitly synthetic and is not a rendered PDF claim.

resolvedFindings.priority: P1 for targeted fixture validity only
resolvedFindings.scenario: The real financial session is frozen, so the method-capture test cannot demonstrate replacement by assigning new methods directly to it.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The test now builds a mutable narrow getState/subscribe adapter forwarding to the real shared financial session, creates the export owner with that adapter, replaces both adapter methods with throwing functions, and then reads the actual quote through the existing handler. This exercises synchronous method capture without changing or bypassing the real session state or subscription.

observations.finding: Selector is captured by the shared strict validator; URL encodes only F/E/language/pdf and saved quote ID. Response checks tenant/F/L/USD/language/format/selector SHA/content SHA, positive bounded E/C/S, current_at_export basis and exact deterministic estimate filename before streaming. C/S are response observations, not client-supplied authority.

Captures real owner object and method references synchronously. Estimate guards require ready status, same tenant/exact F and no top-level financial refresh debt/pending/writing. Subscription invalidates ownerEpoch, cancellation, streams and estimate URLs. Success awaits renew current guards; rejected waits enter catch current guard. Stop/denial are terminal; temporary write/F/debt invalidation does not terminally dispose the task.

One synchronous export flight. Cleanup releases it on success/failure/timeout. Export observes only getState/subscribe and never sends a financial write, resets pending, changes financial/bank floors or claims historical receipt as a new head. Written real-session tests cover six uncertain operation kinds and same-F retry/reload behavior; no execution claim is made here.

Readiness ignores bank.requiresRefresh and bankRevision. External B-only and bank read error can preserve an owned quote at same F; local bank write publishes common writing/pending and invalidates it. This matches the tracked plan.

Cookie-only same-origin GET with no-referrer, no-store and redirect error. Deadline covers digest/fetch/stream/digest. Bounded error body and allowlisted public code; 401/402/403 dispose without trusting body. finally aborts controller and cancels received body even when no reader was created; late aborted fetch cancels its body on resolution.

Frozen result/immutable Blob plus WeakMap stamp rejects clones and foreign sessions. Checks owner epoch and source before creating and clicking link, checks again after reentrant DOM creation, and revokes URL on invalidation/dispose/failure. Written test covers synchronous stop during link creation.

Copy distinguishes current seller/saved customer, before sales tax, missing/current identity, source missing, pending/debt and quote size. Existing parent exportDenied is passed through commercial to action; financial owner reference is an actual effect dependency. Root-owned React hook lint repairs are outside this three-file review and remain subject to root final checks.

observations: Only selector.kind === estimate creates quoteParties. The old invoice/report party loop remains the fallback with its existing draw/pagination semantics, so those branches are not switched to columns.

This layout uses ordinary floating-point PDF geometry only; quote quantities, basis-point discounts and monetary totals continue to come from the exact validated snapshot and string formatters.

The four-language real V5 quote test now requires parsed.pages === 1 while retaining exact amounts, percentage text, current/historical identity, E/C/S labels, complete notice, Letter geometry and every-glyph bounds assertions.

The101-line historical-client scenario retains multipage and final-line/final-note assertions. Existing invoice/report tests are still present; no assertion was weakened to hide the candidate1 layout issue.

security.operation: Read-only quote PDF; no acceptance, issuance, payment, email, journal or durable export receipt.
security.identity: Private exact seller-head select and country reader under repeated full pilot admission, separate versioned C/S fences and exact F/E. The legacy seller RPC and postpromotion seller/country freeze remain intact. No browser seller payload and no fiscal merchant fallback.
security.owner: Actual shared financial owner observed synchronously; pending/writing/debt/stop/denial invalidate quote files and URLs without modifying pending or financial/bank floors.

limits: Private local US TEST pilot only. No certified US GAAP, tax compliance, legal archive, hosted Auth/D1/PG, external provider, native-platform or production guarantee.
Successive C1/S/C2, identity/head and admission fences are not one atomic F+C+S+Auth/D1 transaction; they do not prove no later change.

The cumulative PostgreSQL foundation freezes seller and country heads/history after V5 promotion. Its real seller correction occurs before promotion; postpromotion corrections and no-ops remain refused. Mutable C/S changes during awaits are separate controlled-memory handler cases, not evidence of allowed PostgreSQL profile editing.

The2097152-byte quote snapshot JSON budget is checked after structural capture. Existing capture bounds values/nodes/depth, not property-name character allocation. No preallocation or arbitrary-input memory cap is claimed. The server constructs closed snapshots; the public route accepts no snapshot body.
Current seller at export is explicit; the customer stays as saved in the quote until explicit resave. This is not a newly invented historical seller identity.
Grouped local four-language/two-theme/desktop/mobile browser recipe is not a full cross-product UI matrix or a real iPhone/macOS/Android application.
Synthetic loopback harness serializes ordinary requests; immediate proof/font/authority/country/seller controls bypass the queue. It is not DB concurrency, load or durability evidence.
The Vite adapter does not propagate HTTP disconnect into Request.signal. Browser cancellation prevents adoption/download, while a handler may finish under its own deadline.
The browser download-event API timed out. The retained actual UI PDF is checked by exact length/SHA against server attempt1; no successful event API observation is claimed.
Archive manifest intentionally excludes NodeFS/data/temp directories and unlisted file types. Historical preservation rows separately fingerprint retained old evidence and generated archives.
Final targeted/regression counts overlap. Historical failed attempts remain attached; passing selected tests do not certify every module or all product behavior.
